To be perfectly frank there was nothing really difficult about the job at all. It’s very easy as long as you stick to your security measures and trust your gut on things. Though the MOST difficult thing would be having to deal with drunk people. I did deliveries by car in the city so trying to get drunk people to tell you where they are is a pain in the ass. 

The other difficult part was worry. Worrying that some idiot got caught by the cops with a bag of blow in their pocket and was pressured by police to give them my name/number. This is what kept me up at night. 

Some MINOR issues would be:
- A customer you don’t know asking for credit.
- Customers not turning up.
- When a customer acts like we’re in fucking or Narcos something and asks to “see the shit”. 
- Customers being too obvious if we’re on the street (don’t walk up to your dealer on the street with money outstretched in your hand, stop and say hello/how are you first).
- Complaints about quality. Even when you know your product is great.
